## Procedure and coverage

Official 1.2 file as DCOLYMP/E1449999.BIN, hold OK while powering on; front light steady about a minute then about 2 Hz until switched off.

- The hold-OK SD update trigger and the success light pattern work on this body.
- Setup > Firmware shows 1.2 afterwards.
